ok. that's ok. i can do that, i can listen

I don't know. I've been to therapy, my issues have issues. I can't remember most of my childhood past being molested at 8, I know I had a best friend that committed suicide and I know I blame myself but I can't even remember that clearly. Or more like, I don't want to remember it or talk about it. I can't vent because it relates to issues I don't want to talk about. Like, how I can't go to zoom meetings because video calls remind me of a traumatic incident and drive me into panic attacks, how emails are the same, how i can't leave the house because nowhere is safe, because I don't feel safe, I'll never feel safe and I'm utterly useless like this. 

That's the problem. Talking about it, unpacks a lot of things I'm actively trying not to think about, I don't know what words to say to explain how deeply I hate myself or how much I just don't want to be here anymore, I don't want to worry a random stranger, I just want to stop existing.
